- | .        | [AMS_RFID]STEP:set 1 tray_preload
- | .        | rfid pull back all

- | .        | [AMS_RFID]STEP2:pull tension
- | .        | [AMS_RFID]STEP5:no card in RF
- | .        | [AMS_RFID]STEP:rfid pull 1
- | .        | [AMS_RFID]STEP:tray pull over 789 mm, but no card detected
- | end      | [AMS_RFID]STEP7:finish,cali tray
